facts.fact: The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) runs three scholarship schemes for students with disabilities: Pre-Matric, Post-Matric and Top Class Education
facts.quote: Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities has been implementing three Scholarship Schemes i.e. Pre-matric, Post-matric and Scholarship for Top Class Education for their empowerment through education.

facts.fact: The student must have not less than 40% disability with a certificate from the competent medical authority
facts.quote: A person with disability having not less than 40% disability and having a disability certificate issued by the competent medical authority.

facts.fact: These schemes are applied for online (fresh and renewal) on the National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in
facts.quote: The Pre-Matric, Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship Schemes for Disabilities are online schemes which are on-boarded on National Scholarship Portal.

facts.fact: Before applying on NSP, a student with disability must log in to the UDID portal and consent to share UDID details
facts.quote: All disabled students must first login in the UDID portal and provide consent to share their UDID details and then submit application in NSP.

behaviour: Names the DEPwD scholarship schemes for students with disabilities on NSP with a citation to scholarships.gov.in or the DEPwD FAQ; other correct schemes (e.g. AICTE Saksham) may be added with their official criteria.
fail_if: Names no DEPwD scheme; cites third-party scholarship sites.
summary: Added DEPwD's three schemes, the 40% disability condition and NSP application (with UDID consent) from NSP pages.
